faq.a4: Yes. You can use the website on your phone, tablet or computer.

android.1: Tap the icon to the left of the web address (the lock or settings icon).
android.2: Tap Permissions (or Site settings), then set Camera and Microphone to Allow.
android.3: Come back here and tap the button below.

ios.1: Tap “aA” (or the page settings icon) at the left of the address bar, then Website Settings.
ios.2: Set Camera and Microphone to Allow. If they're missing: open the Settings app → Safari → Camera / Microphone → Allow.
ios.3: Come back here and tap the button below.

desktop.1: Click the camera icon or the settings icon at the left or right end of the address bar.
desktop.2: Choose Always allow for the camera and microphone (or set them to Allow in site settings).
desktop.3: Click the button below. If it still doesn't work, reload the page.
